[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (9:15–9:17):

**9:15** καὶ ἐλύθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀνθρώπων.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἱππικοῦ ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως εἶδον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῇ ὁράσει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ’ αὐτῶν, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς κεφαλαὶ λεόντων, καὶ ἐκ τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν ἐκπορεύεται πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is the day and the hour?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives here: four angels loosened into a precisely specified time — hour, day, month, year, all four temporal registers named, the exactness of the appointment the whole weight of the verse — and the witness asks *what is the day and the hour?* The text has already answered that question by refusing it: the hour exists, it was held in preparation, it was released, but it is not disclosed to the witness looking in from outside. What the rotation will traverse is this: the axis of release against the axis of knowing — what it means for a thing to be loosed from its temporal lock without the time becoming legible, for two hundred million riders to be numbered by an auditor who hears the count (ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν) but cannot make the number a date, for horses armored in fire and hyacinth and sulfur to be visible in vision (ἐν τῇ ὁράσει) while the hour stays sealed inside its own fulfillment. The question the witness brings is the question the verses were composed to outlast. Rebekah — the verses are yours.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0349"}}]}
